description: List every asset the swap form knows: slug (the network is part of the slug, e.g. usdt-trc20, usdt-erc20), ticker, network, confirmations, the name of the extra id (memo, tag, payment ID) where the chain uses one, and whether the asset is available right now. Use it first, to turn a coin name into the slug that get_limits, get_quote, validate_address and create_swap expect. Not the list of documented routes: for the routes with their own page use list_routes. Returns the whole catalogue in one call, unavailable assets included with their availability flag; availability can change between calls. No arguments.
name: list_assets
title: List assets
